description: This file defines the OperatorValidator class within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters validators namespace. It implements validation logic for checking if a given value is a valid operator, specifically verifying that the input is a string.

classes.name: OperatorValidator
classes.description: A validator class that ensures a filter operator is a string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a string and throws an exception if not.
